h1: Shade House BITEC Bangna — free parking, spacious rooms and eight minutes from BITEC on foot
intro: If you're exhibiting or attending an event at BITEC Bang Na and want somewhere close enough to walk — same side of the road, no crossing Bang Na's heavy traffic — with free parking and a price that leaves room in the budget, Shade House BITEC Bangna is one of the properties that repeatedly comes up in the area. It sits on Bangna-Trat Soi 4, roughly 750 m from the BITEC entrance — an 8-minute walk staying on the same pavement, no road crossing needed. The hotel has 17 to 20 rooms, free in-building parking, free Wi-Fi and a small on-site café. Rooms start at about ฿700 per night in the low season. Score: 7.7 from 31 real reviews on Trip.com, and 6.0 on Booking.com — numbers that reflect a property with a clear positional strength but real weak spots you should know about before booking.

body.html: Shade House BITEC Bangna is a small, independently run budget hotel tucked into Bangna-Trat Soi 4, about 750 m from the entrance of BITEC Bangkok International Trade and Exhibition Centre. The walk takes around eight minutes at a relaxed pace, and — this matters more than it sounds — the hotel is on the same side of Bang Na Road as BITEC, so there is no need to navigate the busy multi-lane crossing. Guests who've attended multi-day expos at the venue mention this as a genuine practical advantage, particularly in the early morning before footbridges fill up. The hotel has 17 to 20 air-conditioned rooms and offers free in-building parking, which is in short supply near the venue on major event days.

Rooms come in three main configurations: Superior Twin (two single beds), Deluxe Twin and Deluxe King (one large double). All rooms include an air conditioner, a flat-screen TV, a refrigerator and an en-suite bathroom with a hot-water shower. The most consistent praise in real guest reviews is that the rooms feel bigger than the price suggests, with comfortable beds and working air conditioning noted by Trip.com reviewers who scored the property 7.7 overall. The flip side is cleanliness: Booking.com's cleanliness score sits at 5.7 out of 10, with guest comments mentioning floors that had been swept but not mopped, debris left in bathrooms from previous guests, and stained bedding in a handful of cases. This inconsistency is the most important thing to know before choosing this hotel.
"Great location — same side as BITEC so no crossing the main road. Room was bigger than expected and the bed was comfortable. The bathroom could have been cleaner though."

On-site facilities are practical and minimal. Free in-building parking, free Wi-Fi throughout the property, a small café, room service and luggage storage cover the basics. A 7-Eleven is directly across the road for late-night supplies. What is absent: no pool, no gym, no restaurant with a full menu, and no breakfast included. Toiletries cover soap and shampoo, but several reviewers noted missing items such as a toothbrush or tea mugs to accompany the kettle — bring your own or pick up supplies at the convenience store. The single biggest practical constraint is the absence of an elevator: guests on upper floors carry luggage up stairs, which is inconvenient for anyone travelling with heavy bags, older travellers or families with young children.

The neighbourhood puts the hotel in a convenient outer-Bangkok grid. Central Bangna is about 3 km away by car. Mega Bangna with its IKEA is around 5 km. Bangkok Mall — the large new development in the area — is reachable in a short drive. BTS Bang Na (E13) is roughly 1.5 km from the hotel, and from Bang Na you can connect to the Yellow Line or take the train back into central Bangkok. Suvarnabhumi Airport sits around 15 km away — a 20 to 25-minute drive — making this a passable choice for travellers with an early morning flight after an event.

To frame the score honestly: 7.7 on Trip.com and 6.0 on Booking.com reflect the same reality from two different angles. Trip.com reviewers (31 reviews) weighted location and value highly, lifting the overall number. Booking.com reviewers (17 reviews) weighted cleanliness and facilities, pulling it down — location scored 7.6, cleanliness 5.7, facilities 5.5. Neither figure is wrong. This is a hotel that delivers on proximity and parking, but cannot reliably deliver on the cleanliness standard most travellers expect from a 3-star property. For a one-night exhibition trip where you're out at the venue most of the day, that trade-off may be entirely acceptable. For anything longer, or for guests who place real weight on cleanliness, the options further up the Bang Na ranking are worth the extra spend.

Practical notes from tracking real guest feedback: request a room on the ground floor with a window at the time of booking — some rooms have no window, and without an elevator, upper-floor rooms become a chore with luggage. During major BITEC events, rates climb and the hotel fills quickly; book two to four weeks ahead to secure the lower rack rate. Wi-Fi in the upper floors has been reported as slow in some reviews, so if you need a reliable connection for video calls during a trade show, plan accordingly.

honestSummary: Shade House BITEC Bangna has one clear, genuine strength: proximity to BITEC with free parking and no road crossing. If that solves the problem you're trying to solve — arriving by car, attending a multi-day trade show, not wanting to pay for off-site parking — this property does exactly what it promises at a very low price. But it cannot promise consistent cleanliness, it has no elevator, and some rooms have no windows. Come in with accurate expectations and you may leave satisfied; come in expecting a standard 3-star and you may not.
honestChecks: If cleanliness is a dealbreaker for you — the 5.7 cleanliness score on Booking.com and multiple reviews citing dirty bathrooms are not anomalies. Look at the Takka Hotel or Cubic Bangna further up the ranking if you need more reliable housekeeping standards.

If you're travelling with heavy luggage, an elderly companion or young children — there is no elevator. Request a ground-floor room explicitly at booking; without that, you'll be hauling bags up stairs.

If you need a window in your room — some rooms at this property have none. Specify 'room with window' at booking or check-in; it makes a meaningful difference in comfort for anything longer than a one-night stopover.

tips.title: Request ground floor with a window

tips.title: Book early around major BITEC events
tips.body: Rates at this hotel and all its neighbours spike sharply when large trade shows or expos are on at BITEC. Book two to four weeks in advance to secure the standard rate and ensure availability.

tips.title: Pack your own toiletries
tips.body: Multiple reviewers note that supplies like toothbrushes, or cups for the in-room kettle, were missing. Pack your own or pick up anything you need at the 7-Eleven directly across the road.

tips.title: Park early on busy event days
tips.body: In-building parking is free but limited. On days with large events at BITEC, arrive at the hotel and claim your space before the area fills. The walk to BITEC is under 10 minutes from the car park.

faq.q: Where is Shade House BITEC Bangna and how far is it from BITEC?
faq.a: The hotel is at 10 Bangna-Trat Soi 4, Bang Na Road, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na district, Bangkok 10260. BITEC is approximately 750 m away — about an 8-minute walk — and the hotel sits on the same side of Bang Na Road as BITEC, so there is no need to cross the busy main road. This is a practical advantage over hotels on the opposite side of Bang Na Road.

faq.q: How much do rooms at Shade House BITEC Bangna cost?
faq.a: The Superior Twin room starts at about ฿700 per night in the low season. Deluxe Twin is around ฿900 and Deluxe King around ฿950. Rates rise noticeably during major BITEC events — book two to four weeks ahead and compare prices on Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com.

faq.q: Does Shade House BITEC Bangna have free parking?
faq.a: Yes — free in-building parking is included. This is one of the hotel's main selling points for event attendees who drive to BITEC; off-site parking near the venue charges significant fees on busy event days. Spaces are limited, so arrive early on high-traffic event days.

faq.q: Does Shade House BITEC Bangna have an elevator?
faq.a: No, there is no elevator. Upper-floor rooms require carrying luggage up stairs. If you have heavy bags, are travelling with an elderly companion or have any mobility concerns, request a ground-floor room explicitly at the time of booking.

faq.q: How clean is Shade House BITEC Bangna?
faq.a: Cleanliness is the property's main weak point based on real guest reviews. The Booking.com cleanliness score is 5.7 out of 10, with reviewers noting floors that were swept but not mopped, residue in bathrooms and occasionally stained bedding. Trip.com's overall score of 7.7 is higher, partly because those reviewers weighted location heavily. It's worth inspecting the room on arrival before unpacking.

faq.q: Who is Shade House BITEC Bangna best suited for?
faq.a: Best for travellers driving to a BITEC event who want free parking and a short, no-crossing walk to the venue at the lowest possible nightly rate. Less well suited to guests who prioritise cleanliness standards, need an elevator, or plan to stay more than two or three nights.
